verdict.rationale: Skyfire is an agentic-commerce payments and identity layer, so querying an order's status after purchase is a fair question to ask of it. The pack documents no order-status or shipment-tracking capability. Token introspection (whether a token is usable and its remaining balance) and wallet-balance pendingCharges are adjacent payment-state features, not order status or tracking, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can query the status and tracking of an order it placed, after the purchase
